artifacts.response:
Spec — P2

Source: `src/ergora/data/console/candidate-review.js`, `save()` success message; corroborated by `src/ergora/issues.py`, `link_review()` final `previous` branch.

Trigger: two clients explicitly save the same unsaved candidate association concurrently. Both can perform the provider reads before one persists the record. The other then returns that existing record with `fresh_observations=false`.

Consequence: the UI says “本次没有重新读取平台” even though this request read the platform. The flag distinguishes the returned saved observations; it does not guarantee that this invocation performed no reads. This misstates evidence and runtime cost.

Minimal correction: remove the no-platform-read claim. For example: “返回原已保存关联；显示的是原不可变记录，新的原因不覆盖原内容。” Keep backend ownership, flags and recovery semantics unchanged.

Standards

No additional reachable structural findings. The new module cohesively owns association, explicit recovery and SHA lookup despite having one production caller. It reuses `api.js` and `ui.js`; HTTP routes delegate to the existing issue owner. Native identity checks, persistence, conflict handling and revision checks remain in `issues.link_review`. No new scheduler, ledger, provider dispatch or testing infrastructure is visible in this scope.

Complete reviewed scope

Read both declared workflow/agent instructions and both Skills completely, plus all continuous UTF-8 candidate pages through `next_offset: null`, including these nine complete attachments:

- `src/ergora/data/console/candidate-review.js`
- `src/ergora/data/console/tasks.js`
- `src/ergora/data/console/api.js`
- `src/ergora/data/console/ui.js`
- `src/ergora/issues.py`
- `src/ergora/tasks.py`
- `src/ergora/web.py`
- `docs/plans/2026-11-12-review-context-console.md`
- `docs/delivery/2026-11-12-review-context-console.md`

This is a review of those attachments, not full-repository or delivery certification. The reported 74 checks, two controlled native seeds and package/frozen-file checks are supplied evidence. Browser behavior, final documentation, independent validation and exact delivery remain unverified. No shell, network, tests or workspace edits were performed.
